purpose: Freeze the V4 geometry-repair method before any ground truth is used to score it. V1, V2 and V3 are preserved untouched.
hypothesis: The remaining localisation damage comes not from low-confidence pseudo keypoints but from moderately confident ones whose coordinates are wrong. Rejecting or ignoring them removes noise but produces no better target. Reconstructing their 2D position from reliable high-confidence corners and the registered object geometry can produce a target more accurate than the teacher's own.

new_threshold_this_track.justification: 0.95 was selected during method development because the remaining nighttime degradation was concentrated in teacher keypoints with confidence between 0.80 and 0.95 (delta NME +0.02170 there against +0.00212 at >=0.95).

thresholds_reused_unchanged.min_anchors_note: Reuses the existing min_valid_corners = 6. Not a new tuning parameter.

keypoint_tiers.naming: c_i is the teacher keypoint confidence. It is never called a calibrated probability.

supervision_contract.box: top-1 detection exists AND box_conf >= 0.85. Keypoint state never gates box supervision.
supervision_contract.high_confidence_corner: Used as a raw target only if it ALSO passes the existing per-keypoint removal and flip consistency. Otherwise true-ignore.
supervision_contract.repair_candidate: V4-C only. Reconstructed from anchors; true-ignore if reconstruction fails.
supervision_contract.ambiguous_frame: q >= 0.75 -> corners 0..7 true-ignore, no repair attempted. Box supervision kept; centroid may still be used.
supervision_contract.centroid: raw teacher centroid used only if kp_conf_8 >= 0.95 AND flip consistency <= 0.05. Never repaired by PnP - it is not a cuboid corner.
supervision_contract.zero_mask_instance: A frame with every keypoint ignored is not removed; it still contributes box and class supervision.

repair_algorithm.anchors: corners j != i with c_j >= 0.95 AND removal consistency PASS AND flip consistency PASS. The candidate never contributes to its own fit.
repair_algorithm.hypotheses: All deployment-valid W/D hypotheses from OBJECT_GEOMETRY_REGISTRY. Ground-truth pose, ground-truth axis assignment and ground-truth width/depth selection are never used.
repair_algorithm.hypothesis_validity: median anchor reprojection error / projected cuboid diagonal <= 0.05

consensus_rule.one_valid: that projection becomes the repaired target
consensus_rule.many_valid_and_agreeing: max pairwise distance between candidate projections / projected diagonal <= 0.05 -> mean of the projections

repair_algorithm.consensus_principle: The method never picks which 6D hypothesis is correct. It only uses the cases where every deployment-valid hypothesis agrees on the 2D location.
repair_algorithm.out_of_image: A repaired target outside the image is discarded, not clipped. Clipping would hide bad geometry.

pnp_role: latent operator for refining a 2D pseudo target only

arms.V4A_BOX_ONLY: All 273 accepted frames give box and class supervision; every keypoint true-ignored.
arms.V4B_HIGHCONF_ONLY: V4-A plus raw targets for high-confidence geometry-reliable corners and the centroid rule.
arms.V4C_GEOMETRY_REPAIR: V4-B plus geometry repair of repair-candidates. THIS IS V4 PROPOSED.

training_contract.checkpoint: fixed last.pt; PAPER_EVAL is never used to select an epoch

proxy_gate_before_training.P1: Night repaired median NME < raw teacher median NME
proxy_gate_before_training.P3: Report the actual N of repaired candidates. Do not invent a minimum N threshold; mark LOW_POWER when the count cannot support the comparison.
proxy_gate_before_training.on_failure: GEOMETRY_REPAIR_MECHANISM_FAIL. Stop without training. Do not adjust thresholds to make it pass.

dev_gate.G3: V4-C paired common-frame NME delta vs R0 < 0
dev_gate.G4: V4-C Night paired NME delta vs R0 <= 0
dev_gate.G5: V4-C paired NME < V4-B paired NME
dev_gate.G6: V4-C Night NME < V4-B Night NME
dev_gate.G9: G1/G2 passing does not rescue a G3/G4 failure

pool_audit_before_lock.note: The pool audit is ground-truth free and was run before this lock, as the protocol directs. Its numbers are recorded here because they bound what the training arms can possibly show.
pool_audit_before_lock.implication: V4-C and V4-B differ by exactly one supervised keypoint out of 2184 in the training set. Gates G5 and G6, which ask whether repair beats V4-B, therefore have essentially no statistical power regardless of how well repair works. This is recorded before any result is seen.

no_sweep_after_results: A development failure is recorded as V4_METHOD_STATUS = FAILED, with SINGLE_FRAME_SELFTRAINING_DEV_BUDGET_EXHAUSTED = true. No V5 is designed against PAPER_EVAL 319.
